optionalRemoteServices.ai: Optional. The app must continue using the local tutor when no provider is configured.
optionalRemoteServices.community: Optional. Forum synchronization is not part of the sovereign base.
optionalRemoteServices.externalLinks: Reference links only. They are not required to read the local curriculum.

mediaPolicy.videos: Optional and intentionally excluded from the base package.
mediaPolicy.largeAssets: May be added as separately licensed local packages.

reviewPolicy.legalHealthAndAdministrativeContent: Requires periodic human review against current official sources before operational use.
reviewPolicy.translations: Must be reviewed by qualified speakers before publication as final material.
reviewPolicy.assets: Only assets with a compatible license or original project ownership may be bundled.
